title: 第80章 天佑南山第79章 天降克星
content_zh:
登仙楼内，尘埃落定。
窦岳亭收刀而立，老夫子拂尘轻扫，望着地上被缚的五贼，神色间仍有惊异。
南山郡虽仙道衰微，法种境修士并非没有。
要胜过五贼不难，难的是留住他们。
这群人旁门左道，或能飞天，或能遁地，或能放毒，手段诡异，多年来无人能真正将其擒获，才纵容得他们越发猖狂。
可吴燃灯明明只是炼气境，竟能跨越一个大境界，将五贼尽数降服。
“吴燃灯，你是怎么做到的？”老夫子终究按捺不住好奇，这位博闻强识的仙塾执掌，此刻眼中满是探究。
吴燃灯指尖轻捻，将捆仙绳的余劲散去，淡淡道：“说起来，他们坏就坏在自己的名号上，被我所炼制的六件符宝所克！”
他看向摸着天的方向：“摸着天，善无形杀音与腾空之术。杀音靠震荡心神，我便以落魄钟的扰魂之音反制。腾空靠皮膜乘风，腾空灵活，却恰恰也防不住自己的无形杀音。”
又指向一刀绝：“一刀绝，单臂蓄力，刀出必见血。其势在‘锐’，我便以阴阳镜的红白二气乱其神，趁他失神时，借老夫子的擒拿术锁其形。”
“三眼乌，第三只眼能喷火线，恃‘目’而骄。我便以戳目珠专破眼目神通，断其攻势。”
“美人蛇，毒雾蛊虫阴邪至极，畏‘阳’怕‘烈’。五火七禽扇聚五火之威，引七禽祥瑞，正好以正阳之火荡尽妖邪。”
最后看向土相公：“土相公，善土遁，能与大地相融，恃‘遁’而安。我便以遁龙桩的镇土符文锁其地脉，金环专锁其游走之窍，让他无处可藏。”
吴燃灯娓娓道来，将五贼的独门法术特性、破绽所在，以及自己如何以六件一次性符宝精准克制的过程，一一说清。
堂中众人听得面面相觑，先是恍然，随即咋舌。
原来如此！
他竟是将五贼的名号、手段研究得通透，每一步都踩在对方的破绽上，以己之长攻彼之短，硬生生以炼气境的修为，布下了一张天罗地网。
窦岳亭抚掌赞叹：“以术破术，以巧破力。吴隐官这份心思，比法种境的修为更难得。”
老夫子也点头：“知己知彼，方能百战不殆。你这法子，看似取巧，实则暗合道法，妙哉。”
吴燃灯微微躬身：“不过是顺水推舟罢了。若无诸位相助，单凭我一人，也难成此事。”

吴燃灯虽口称“顺水推舟”，但满堂修士皆是明眼人，如何不知其中关节？
知晓破绽是一回事，能同时备下六件针对性的符宝，且在乱战中精准施用，步步掐住五贼的咽喉，这绝非“取巧”二字能概括。
没有博览道经、洞悉万法的底蕴，怎可能一眼看穿旁门左道的根脚？
没有对符术的极致掌控，又怎能让一次性符宝发挥出这般绝杀之威？
地上，被捆得结结实实的五贼听得真切，目眦欲裂。
他们苦练数十年的独门法术，在对方口中竟成了破绽百出的玩物，那些引以为傲的神通，被拆解、被克制，简单得如同剥去一层纸。
原来自己多年的横行，在真正的道法大家眼里，竟与小丑无异。
摸着天死死咬着牙，铁扇的扇骨几乎被他捏碎。
一刀绝单臂青筋暴起，断骨处传来的剧痛，远不及心头的屈辱。
美人蛇毒鳞脱落，眼中流下的不知是血还是泪。
三眼乌瞎眼处仍在渗血，喉咙里发出嗬嗬的悲鸣。
土相公被金环锁着要害，浑身泥土簌簌掉落，再无半分“与地相融”的从容。
这般凄惨景象，连一旁观战的仙族修士都暗自摇头。
是啊，五贼横行多年，靠的不过是旁门手段的诡异，遇上吴燃灯这般通晓万法、能精准破局的万法修士，岂不是撞上了天生的克星？
旁门左道，终究难敌大道三千的底蕴。
窦岳亭挥手示意甲士将五贼押下，转身对吴燃灯道：“这些人交由靖仙司处置，按律定罪，以儆效尤。”
吴燃灯点头，目光掠过被拖走的五贼，没有半分波澜。
对他而言，这不是恩怨了结，只是扫清了南山符业路上的一块绊脚石。
登仙楼外，乌云散尽，阳光普照。
content_en:
In the Dengxian Tower, the dust has settled.
Dou Yueting put away his sword and stood up. The old master swept the dust with his fly whisk and looked at the five thieves bound on the ground, still looking surprised.
Although the Immortal Way in Nanshan County has declined, there are still monks in the Dharma Realm.
It is not difficult to defeat the five thieves, but it is difficult to retain them.
This group of people has various tricks, some can fly, some can hide on the ground, some can spread poison, and their methods are weird. No one has been able to really capture them for many years, so they are allowed to become more and more rampant.
But Wu Randeng was clearly only in the Qi Refining realm, but he was able to cross a large realm and surrender all five thieves.
"Wu Randeng, how did you do it?" The old master couldn't restrain his curiosity after all. The knowledgeable and knowledgeable Xian Shu master was in charge, and his eyes were full of inquiry at this moment.
Wu Randeng gently twisted his fingertips to dissipate the remaining energy of the immortal rope, and said calmly: "Speaking of which, their bad name is because they were defeated by the six talismans I refined!"
He looked in the direction of Touching the Sky: "Touching the Sky is good at invisible killing sounds and soaring into the sky. The killing sounds rely on shocking the mind, so I countered with the soul-disturbing sound of the Bell of Desolation. Soaring in the air relies on the skin to ride the wind, and the flying is flexible, but it happens that I can't prevent my own invisible killing sounds."
Then he pointed at Yi Dao Jue: "With Yi Dao Jue, one arm accumulates strength. When the sword comes out, blood will be seen. His power is 'sharp', so I use the red and white energy of the Yin Yang Mirror to disrupt his mind. When he is distracted, I use the old master's grappling skills to lock his form."
"Three-eyed crow, the third eye can spit out fire lines, and he is proud of his 'eye'. So I used the eyeball to penetrate the magical power of the eye and interrupt its offensive."
"Beautiful snakes and poisonous fog bugs are extremely yin and evil. They are afraid of 'yang' and 'violent'. Five fires and seven bird fans gather the power of the five fires and attract the auspiciousness of the seven birds. They just use the fire of righteousness and yang to drive away evil spirits."
Finally, he looked at Tu Xianggong: "Tu Xianggong is good at Earth Escape, can blend with the earth, and relies on 'escape' to be at peace. I then used the earth-suppressing runes of the Escape Dragon Stake to lock his earth veins, and the golden ring specifically locked his wandering orifice, so that he had nowhere to hide."
Wu Randeng spoke eloquently, explaining the characteristics of the five thieves' unique spells, their flaws, and how he accurately restrained them with six disposable talismans.
Everyone in the hall looked at each other in shock, first in astonishment, and then speechless.
I see!
He actually studied the names and methods of the five thieves thoroughly, stepping on each other's weaknesses at every step, using his own strengths to attack the other's weaknesses, and forcefully using his Qi Refining Realm cultivation to lay a dragnet.
Dou Yueting put his palms together and praised: "Use skills to defeat skills, use skill to defeat strength. Wu Yinguan's thoughts are even more rare than the cultivation of Dazhong realm."
The old master also nodded: "Only when you know yourself and your enemy can you win a hundred battles. This method of yours seems to be clever, but it actually coincides with Taoism. It's wonderful."
Wu Randeng bowed slightly: "It's just pushing the boat along. Without everyone's help, it would be difficult for me to do this alone."
Although Wu Randeng claimed to "go with the flow", the monks in the hall were all discerning people, so how could they not know the joints?
Knowing the flaws is one thing. Being able to prepare six targeted talismans at the same time and use them accurately in a chaotic battle to seize the throats of the five thieves step by step cannot be summed up by the word "tricks".
Without an extensive reading of the Taoist scriptures and a thorough understanding of the fundamentals of all dharma, how can we possibly see through the roots of heresy at a glance?
Without the ultimate control over talismans, how could a one-time talisman exert such devastating power?
On the ground, the five thieves, who were tied tightly, heard this so clearly that their eyes were about to burst.
The unique spells they had practiced for decades turned into playthings full of flaws in the opponent's mouth. Those magical powers they were proud of were dismantled and restrained, as simple as peeling off a layer of paper.
It turns out that in the eyes of real Taoists, he has been acting rampant for many years, and he is no different than a clown.
Touching Tian gritted his teeth so hard that the bones of the iron fan were almost crushed by him.
The veins in Yi Dao Jue's arm popped out, and the severe pain from the broken bone was far less than the humiliation in his heart.
The venomous scales of the beauty snake fell off, and I don't know whether it was blood or tears flowing from its eyes.
Blood was still oozing from the blind spot of the three-eyed black man, and a ho-ho scream came from his throat.
earthThe husband's vitals were locked by a golden ring, and the soil fell from his body, and he no longer had the calmness to "melt with the earth".
Such a miserable scene made even the immortal monks watching the battle secretly shake their heads.
Yes, the Five Thieves have been running rampant for many years, relying only on the weirdness of side methods. When they meet Wu Randeng, a cultivator who knows all kinds of magic and can accurately break the situation, isn't it like running into a natural nemesis?
After all, the heresy and heresy will never be able to defeat Dao Sanqian's foundation.
Dou Yueting waved his hand to the soldiers to take the five thieves down, then turned to Wu Randeng and said: "These people will be handed over to the Jingxian Division and sentenced according to law to serve as a warning to others."
Wu Randeng nodded and glanced over the five thieves who were dragged away without any hesitation.
For him, this is not the settlement of grudges, but the removal of a stumbling block on the road to Nanshan Fuye.
Outside the Dengxian Tower, the dark clouds cleared and the sun shone brightly.
